title: Parts of a Plant Song #shorts | Little Takhti
description:
Sing along with Takhti! Roots drink, the stem holds, leaves catch the sun and flowers make seeds. Find out what plants need and which plants we eat, then shout the answers in the quiz before the clock runs out. For Grade 1 children (ages 6 to 7). Little Takhti is also on Android.

Free printable worksheets, quizzes and games for this topic: https://littletakhti.netlify.app/class-1-science-parts-of-a-plant-worksheets/

Chapters
0:00 Parts of a plant
0:14 Roots and stem
0:30 Sing along
0:45 Leaves and flowers
1:17 What plants need
1:33 Plants we eat
2:37 Sing along

Little Takhti makes free learning for children in Pakistan, Nursery to Grade 3. https://littletakhti.netlify.app
